About Us

My Flow Foundation

Emanating from the Charitable engagements that our Founder Phannie A. Kwegah has previously had, My Flow Foundation was born from the belief that every girl and woman deserves to have their dignity as enshrined in the Constitution of Kenya safeguarded.

Impact

  • 30,000 Packets of Sanitary Pads Distributed
  • 10,000 Dignity Care Packages Distributed
  • 10,000 + Girls impacted
  • 12 Counties visited.
More About Us

Our Values

Mission

My Flow Foundation equips girls and women with menstrual products and knowledge that aids them navigate puberty while in and out of school, help preserve their dignity and help debunk the myths and taboos that surround menstruation
Show more
Show less

Vision

To ensure all girls and women have access and information on menstrual health products and management, are sensitized and educated on sanitation, hygiene, life skills and sexual reproductive health.
Show more
Show less

Goal

End Period Poverty in our communities and empower a generation of confident girls.

Your contribution makes a difference

There are so many ways you can get involved with My Flow Foundation and the End Period Poverty movement. With your support we can change the lives of girls, for good.
